content.title: Byzantine-resilient decentralized online federated learning with Bandit feedback for IoV networks
content.abstract: As a canonical application of computational complex networks, the intelligent Internet of Vehicles (IoV) has attracted significant research interest regarding network security. This paper investigates a class of decentralized federated learning algorithms designed to operate without access to exact gradient information and under Byzantine attacks, in which compromised nodes transmit erroneous data, causing client states to deviate from their normal trajectories.
